metadata.title: UN M49 countries or areas
notes: This is a statistical catalog of countries or areas, not a list of sovereign states or UN members.
Geographic grouping does not establish political affiliation, recognition, or authority.
LDC flags reflect this retrieved snapshot; graduation changes must be refreshed.
M49 LLDC and SIDS groups are statistical compositions set for SDG reporting; UNSD states there is no common UN-wide definition.
Antarctica has no regional assignment in the source; null geography fields preserve that.
Names preserve the official English UN short names, including Naoero (NRU).
M49 excludes separate rows for Kosovo and Taiwan; UNSD FAQ documents optional statistical codes 412 and 158 respectively.
